changes: First release: 130 programs of the Alesis Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex on FX2, played at the originals' own arithmetic.
PROG picks the program and BANK the unit; a message box names each as you turn. STOP, STOP, STOP cuts the tail.
Known issue: on base 0.8.1, right after picking it the first NO only closes the memory box, and slow PROG turns need the FX2 page entered again.
Known issue: the Midiverb II's chorus and flange programs, and 75 programs that need more DSP time, are not in this release.
